description: This file contains functions for managing Urbit channels, including creating, waking, poking, and scrying channels, with external dependencies on API types, error handling, and fetch implementation.

methods.name: putUrbitChannel
methods.description: Performs an HTTP PUT request to update or create a channel on Urbit.

methods.name: pokeUrbitChannel
methods.description: Sends a poke message to a specified Urbit channel.

methods.name: scryUrbitPath
methods.description: Performs a scry request to retrieve data from Urbit at a specified path.

methods.name: wakeUrbitChannel
methods.description: Wakes or activates a Urbit channel.

methods.name: ensureUrbitChannelOpen
methods.description: Ensures a Urbit channel is created and activated.
